risks.risk: The TV may have a dead pixel or a completely non-functional screen.
risks.proof: A photo of the TV powered on and displaying a clear image of a test pattern or a website.

risks.risk: The TV may have a faulty power supply or backlight.
risks.proof: A video showing the TV powering on and the screen turning on.

risks.risk: The TV may be missing essential components like the remote control or power cable.
risks.proof: A photo of the TV with all accessories included.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the TV powered on and displaying a clear image.
Photo of the rear of the TV showing the power cable and input ports.
Photo of the remote control if included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
